name: Caltrops
description: A bag of twenty small iron spikes, made so one point always faces up.
body:
## What it is

Scattered as an action, they cover a 5-foot square. A creature stepping in makes a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw. On a failure it stops for the turn, takes 1 piercing damage and walks 10 feet slower until it regains a hit point. Picking through at half speed is safe.
